plan.reason: With 5D, 24/100 evals used and long stagnation (19) with zero recent improvement, the search is likely over-exploiting. Auto surrogate keeps RBF/quadratic flexibility while data is still sparse. best1 drives toward the incumbent best to escape stagnation, and I raise exploration to 0.6 and local_fraction/radius moderately so the acquisition prunes toward novel regions rather than over-crowding near one optimum. Population 30 with 8 generations fits the remaining budget and keeps surrogate refits cheap.
